messages.subject: Problem with ggplot2 and geom_segment
parts:
Other recipients:
I have created a series of plots used in Shiny, that displays a curve, then adds a pair of lines to show x and y axis intercepts.  This works great.  The lines are red and dashed. I am trying to add a second set of lines showing a different x and y i
I have created a series of plots used in Shiny, that displays a curve, then adds a pair of lines to show x and y axis intercepts.  This works great.  The lines are red and dashed.

I am trying to add a second set of lines showing a different x and y intercept.  These are supposed to be green and solid.

When I add the second set of lines, things get screwed up.  The second set becomes red and solid, the first set becomes green and dashed. 

Any ideas on what is happening?

    qplot(y()$TrueNC,y()$AOQ,data=y(),
          ylab="Average Outgoing Quality",
          xlab="Probability of Nonconformance",
          main="Average Outgoing Quality",
          xlim=c(0.0,1.0),
          ylim=c(initLimit(),plotYLimit()),
          geom="line"
    )+geom_segment(
                   aes(
                      x = probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4],
                      y = 0,
                      xend = probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4],
                      yend = round(max(y()$AOQ),4)+0.01,
                      colour="red"),
                      linetype=2
    )+geom_segment(
                  aes(
                    x = 0,
                    y = approx(y()$TrueNC,y()$AOQ,xout=probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4],method="linear")$y,
                    xend = probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4]+0.03,
                    yend = approx(y()$TrueNC,y()$AOQ,xout=probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4],method="linear")$y,
                    colour="red"),
                    linetype=2
    )+geom_segment(
                  aes(
                    x = approx(y()$AOQ,y()$TrueNC,xout=input$ecr_t,method="linear")$y,
                    y = 0,
                    xend = approx(y()$AOQ,y()$TrueNC,xout=input$ecr_t,method="linear")$y,
                    yend = round(max(y()$AOQ),4)+0.01,
                    colour="green"),
                    linetype=1
    )+geom_segment(
                  aes(
                    x = 0,
                    y = approx(y()$TrueNC,y()$AOQ,xout=probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4],method="linear")$y,
                    xend = approx(y()$AOQ,y()$TrueNC,xout=input$ecr_t,method="linear")$y+0.03,
                    yend = approx(y()$TrueNC,y()$AOQ,xout=probvec2()[2]+probvec2()[4],method="linear")$y,
                    colour="green"),
                    linetype=1
    )+theme(legend.position = "none")
  })

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Problem with ggplot2 and geom_segment
parts:
Hi:

Do you understand the difference between mapping and setting
aesthetics in ggplot2? If you want the colors of the segments to be
red and green, _set_ them to those specific values *outside* of aes(),
not inside. Ditto for linetype. aes() is for _mapping_ plot aesthetics
to variables.

Dennis
